context: Mei and Aoi chat about a mutual friend.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (太郎/加藤/あたし/辞書/そういえば) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そういえば、太郎くん、元気にしてる?
lines.en: Come to think of it, how's Taro doing?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、太郎くん、最近よく会うの。
lines.en: Yeah, I see Taro a lot lately.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 加藤さんとは、まだ仲いいの?
lines.en: Are you still close with Kato?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 加藤さんとも、よく勉強してるよ。
lines.en: I study with Kato a lot too.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あたしも、また混ぜてよ。
lines.en: Let me join in again too.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もちろん!あたし、辞書持ってくね。
lines.en: Of course! I'll bring a dictionary.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そういえば、いい辞書、探してたよね。
lines.en: Come to think of it, you were looking for a good dictionary.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 太郎くんが、おすすめを教えてくれたの。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
